title: Speaking up: when something at work doesn't feel right

narration: Say this is Maya, in finance.
One expense claim doesn't add up.
beats.visual_intent: Maya at her desk; two matching receipts side by side, one figure circled; she reaches for her phone, then pulls her hand back.

grounding.claim: Maya and the duplicate claim are an invented example

narration: Here's what to do with it.
beats.visual_intent: Close on Maya's uneasy face as she looks from the receipts toward the viewer; a quiet beat.

grounding.claim: many people feel the pull to stay quiet

narration: We stay quiet for ordinary reasons.
beats.visual_intent: Three thought bubbles rise one by one over Maya's head, each landing on its question, then dim as she straightens up.

grounding.claim: fear of being wrong
fear of fallout
not my business

beats.misconception: You need proof before you speak up.
narration: Good news: you don't need proof.
Good faith means an honest belief.
beats.visual_intent: The rule large beside Maya: she sets a magnifying glass down on the desk as 'proof' fades and 'honest belief' stays.

grounding.claim: good faith is an honest and reasonable belief
no proof needed, not expected to investigate

narration: Would it look fine in public?
beats.visual_intent: A short checklist beside Maya fills in one line at a time as each question is asked.

grounding.claim: does it break a law, policy or the code
could it harm someone
would it be fine if public

beats.visual_intent: The checklist ticks against the duplicate receipts; Maya nods, decided.

grounding.claim: Maya's answer is part of the invented example

narration: Her manager is often the easiest start.
beats.visual_intent: A path opens from Maya's desk; doors appear along it one at a time, each labelled as it is named, her manager's first.

grounding.claim: the line manager is often the first and easiest route
typical channels
anonymous where offered

beats.misconception: Speaking up just gets you punished.
narration: Then others review it, confidentially where possible.
beats.visual_intent: Maya's note passes to a review desk; the rule large, with a protective shield settling around Maya.

grounding.claim: reviewed by people other than the reporter
confidential as far as possible
policies typically prohibit retaliation for good-faith concerns

narration: Now say the claims lead to her own manager.
on_screen: Her manager is involved. Where now?
beats.visual_intent: The manager's door on the path greys out; Maya stands at the fork. Silent pause.

grounding.claim: the twist is part of the invented example

recall.answer: another channel: another manager, HR, compliance or the speak-up line

beats.misconception: If your manager is involved there is nowhere to go.
narration: HR, compliance, or the speak-up line.
beats.visual_intent: The other doors light up and Maya walks past the greyed one.

grounding.claim: when the manager is involved, use another channel

narration: Back at her desk, Maya sends a calm note.
Notice it. Weigh it. Speak up.
beats.visual_intent: The opening shot returns: Maya at her desk, now relaxed, sends the note and closes her laptop; the pocket rule appears.

grounding.claim: Maya's resolution is part of the invented example
no proof needed

narration: This week, find out which channels you have.
beats.visual_intent: The presenter, warm and brief, beside the row of doors from the path, each with a blank label for the viewer's own organisation.

grounding.claim: channel names vary by organisation
